{Pikachu} shivers in {Front} of the {Beach} hut, cheeks barely sparking. A *helping hand* picks up a bear *hide* and **drapes** it over him, but a spark goes off and the fur stands straight up. {Frodo} limps into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, weary, on bare hairy feet, to plant Sam's tomatoes. {Gandalf} stands in {Front} of the {Boathouse} and casts a glowing spell on a golden *hook*, which he dangles from his staff. It **attracts** bees, then a duck, then a dreamy sailor, all floating towards it as his fireworks sparkle. He smokes his pipe crankily as everything in sight is **attracted**, and the lawn fills with admirers who shall not pass.

{Pikachu} scampers {Inside} the {Funfair} and finds a *dish* holding a *cut cake*. 'Pika!' One Thunderbolt and the dish grows, crackling, into a giant **basin**. Water fills it, kids splash in, and he floats in the **basin** on a slice of cake with cheeks sparking, until a Poké Ball rolls in and catches the lot.

{James Bond} arrives in {Front} of the {Stadium} in his tuxedo and presses a Q gadget that does only one thing: it sprays a chalk line. {Darth Vader} looms into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, breathing loudly, where a *busy man* in dark glasses shuffles cards on a lilo. He bets a golden *shell*, and Vader agrees to **gamble**, nudging the dice with the Force. The dice disobey, and with booming disapproval he **gambles** his cape, his lightsaber and finally his helmet, then swims home breathing twice as loud.

{Sailor Moon} falls into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} onto a pile of *soil* glowing under a *new moon*. She waves her moon wand through a long sparkly transformation, and the soil transforms too, into shiny **plastic**: boats, ducks, a whale. She cries loudly when her tiara turns to **plastic** as well, and Luna squeaks across it.

{Walter White} knocks on the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} house and comes face to face with a *spook*. His hands shake over his beaker: no formula explains it, and he **dreads** what he cannot measure. He squeaks that he is the one who knocks, but the *spook* says Boo, and he **dreads** it so much that his goatee turns white.

{Charlie Brown} sits in the {Basement} of the {Tower} and opens his *mouth* to say 'Good grief', when a *pinch* of pepper flies in. ACHOO! The sneeze sets Snoopy howling and the pots clanging; it's so **noisy** that the tower bells ring. Everybody blames Charlie, naturally, and the boos make it even more **noisy**.

{Naruto} bursts {Inside} the {Hangar} dragging a gigantic **sack** and yelling about ramen. He makes a hand sign and a hundred shadow clones pop out, each hauling a smaller sack, bump, bump, bump. He never gives up opening them, and the last tiny **sack** holds one peanut, which he eats with his headband on crooked.

{Casper} floats on the {Roof} of the {Funfair}, hoping to give each visitor a *warm hug*, but they all run screaming. Only one stays, and Casper's round *mouth* hums, '**Mm-hmm**.' The visitor nods back and hums '**Mm-hmm**' too. Soon the carousel, the clowns and the candyfloss stall nod along, no longer frightened, all humming with the ghost.

{Pikachu} scampers in {Front} of the {Fort}, sparking at a rain cloud until *water drops* pour down into a glassy **lake** on the lawn. A *white dove* lands on it and floats like a swan. 'Pika!' He dips one paw, a Thunderbolt races across the **lake**, and the dove's feathers all stand on end.

{Frodo} staggers into the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} house, worn out after a very long walk, and collapses by a *moon* wearing an *apron*. It fans him as he takes one deep breath, and his **lung** blows up like a balloon, lifting his hairy feet off the ground. Sam pats his back, and with the air from one mighty **lung** he blows every candle out.

The {Joker} leaps into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} on a *horse* and crashes a quiet *gathering* of ducks with a **sudden** bang. A trick playing card explodes into feathers, his flower squirts, and a **sudden** storm of custard pies drops from nowhere. He cackles with his huge grin as the horse rows off in a canoe.

{Charlie Brown} tries to fly his kite {Inside} the {Mansion}, which goes as well as you would expect. Its *silk thread* starts to **wind around** his legs, the banisters and the chandelier, and he trips into a *tangle*. 'Good grief,' he says, hanging upside down, while the thread **winds around** Snoopy, who takes a nap in it.

{Gandalf} strikes his staff on the tarmac in {Front} of the {Hangar}, and with a rumble a long *ridge* erupts like a dragon's back. 'You shall not pass!' he shouts at the taxiing planes, which scrape their tails on the **ridge**. Pleased, he lights his pipe and conjures a second **ridge**, just to annoy the pilots.

{Shrek} roars in {Front} of the {Youth Hostel} at a *clown* trying to kiss a *sheep*. The sheep blushes and hides in his swamp-green shadow: it is so **shy**! The clown, suddenly just as **shy**, ducks behind his red nose, and Shrek, who only wants to be left alone, goes pink himself when Donkey says he has a soft heart.

{Darth Vader} looms into the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle}, beside a *climber* stuck halfway up a tree. He **glares** at her through his helmet, one huge lens like an angry *eye*, breathing loudly, and lifts her down with the Force. She **glares** back, and they stare until the monkeys get bored and the tree looks away.

{Darth Vader} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café} and with one raised finger lifts a *hanging lamp* shaped like a fish to the ceiling. He **hangs up** more with the Force, booming his disapproval at the darkness, and cats swing across on them. Then he **hangs up** his own cape, and a kitten climbs it, purring in time with his breath.

{James Bond} slides into the {Basement} of the {Piazza} and unlocks a dusty *cabinet* with a Q gadget that opens only cabinets. Golden *shell* coins spill out, each stamped with the **surname Jia**. Unruffled, he introduces himself, 'Bond. James Bond,' and an old shopkeeper bursts in, waving a ledger: his is the **surname Jia**, and Bond escapes through a shell-shaped trap door.

{Lara Croft} climbs into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse}, in search of a relic, and *water drops* hit her from a *leaky roof*. It's an ancient trap: each drip opens a sluice, and the boats begin to **leak**. She swings from rafter to rafter, ponytail flying, as the walls, the buckets and even the relic **leak** in a gurgling chorus.

{Batman} crouches in {Front} of the {Mansion} with *twin jades* in his belt as clues, when a *tattoo* gadget misfires on his chest. Instead of a bat, it stamps a **spot**, then another. He scans them, brooding: they form a map, and he glides off covered in **spots** like a leopard, growling at the jades as they turn spotty.

{Tarzan} swings down in {Front} of the {Tower} and drops a *longevity peach* in a bucket of *water drops*, just to see what civilisation does. The bucket boils and launches a **big wave** across the city. With a jungle yell he grabs a vine, calls his elephants and rides the **big wave** on a startled hippo.

{Yoshi} sets off on a *leisurely stroll* in {Front} of the {Boathouse}, his *heart* thumping slow as a drum. He sticks his tongue out at a fly, and it takes an hour, long and **drawn out**. His call of 'Yo-o-o-o-shi' is even more **drawn out**, and by the time he swallows the fly and lays the egg, it's next week.

{Lara Croft} swings into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} on a rope and lands between the antlers of a stone *deer*, a relic doing backstroke. She pulls one antler, the **deer** comes alive, and they gallop across the water with boulders rolling behind. A whole herd of **deer** leaps the traps, and she hangs on by her ponytail.

{Frodo} tiptoes {Inside} the {Pool} on bare hairy feet, where a *standing person* in armour guards a tiny *hatchling* in a cage. He slips on the Ring, vanishes, and ties the guard up with elven rope to **take him prisoner**. Sam cheers, the freed chick hops onto the helmet, pecks it, and **takes it prisoner** too.

{Shrek} sits in {Front} of the {Beach} hut, hoping for peace, and melts Donkey's *gold coins* in an onion pan, but they come out dull grey: **tin**. A *lizard* taps it with its tail and it clinks like a cheap can. Shrek roars, then hammers the **tin** into a muzzle for Donkey, who talks straight through it.

{Batman} glides down in {Front} of the {Lake} house, and a king on a barge hands him a huge *fan*, ordering him to bow. 'Lower!' shouts the king, and he crawls even **lower** until his cape slides into the ditch, the fan waving above him.

{Zorro} swoops into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} on a rope, black cape flying, with a goldfish in a matchbox. He slashes a Z in a mat of *grass* on the floor to **bury** it gently, then his rapier cuts a tiny Z for a headstone. {Mario} bounds {Inside} the {Boxing Ring}, head-butts a block and collects a stream of *gold coins* that fuse into a *name tag*. He stomps his boots on it, tap, tap, tap, and each stomp begins to **engrave** a letter. 'Wahoo!' He **engraves** his own name, since he has stomped every champion flat.

{Tarzan} swings in {Front} of the {Mansion}, baffled by lawns, and gives a yell that brings elephants spraying *water drops* until the grass turns to a sandy **beach**. A *caught bird* wriggles in a butler's net, and Tarzan talks it free. It flops on the **beach** in sunglasses, and he hangs a vine hammock next to it.

{James Bond} escapes into the {Bathroom} of the {Piazza} and lands in a wedding, where a *woman* waits by a little *home* made of flowers. She is about to **marry** a scowling villain, so Q's ring gadget fires one absurd net of confetti, and the groom flees. She vows to **marry** the man who can stay, but Bond, unruffled, has already gone.

{Cookie Monster} bounces in {Front} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *standing person* climbs a *lofty peak* of paperwork to reach the last biscuit. 'Hurry! {Shrek} lumbers {Inside} the {Mint}, where a tiny *king* spins a *spinning top* carved from green **jade**. Shrek, green too, wants quiet, so he roars, and the top only hums louder. He tries to peel it like an onion, but the **jade** has no layers and it bounces off his head, leaving a perfect green bruise nobody can see.

{Charlie Brown} trudges into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} and climbs a *branch* to rescue his kite. It snaps, of course, but *feathers* sprout from his zigzag shirt, then a **wing**, then another. {Homer} naps {Inside} the {Hut} with a *dish* of doughnuts, scheming to keep them safe from himself. {Mario} jumps {Inside} the {Mansion} and meets a *sweating man* in furs, a **barbarian** roaring and swinging a club at a *bug*. Vases smash, and the piano is next. 'Wahoo!' Mario stomps once on the club, twice on the fur hat and collects the coin, and the **barbarian**, flattened like a Goomba, pops up asking for a rematch.

{Yoshi} skids into the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut and finds a *full stop* sitting where the snacks were. He swallows it and lays it as an egg, but it has **already** hatched. It rolls off, saying everyone has **already** eaten and gone home, and Yoshi flutter-jumps after it, tongue flapping, too late for everything.

{Pikachu} scampers in {Front} of the {Mansion} and zaps a *slop bucket* with a Thunderbolt. The slop leaps up, sizzling, and spells **Pan** across the white walls. {Chewbacca} stoops {Inside} the {Beach} hut, where the hallway splits like a *branch* round a *stop sign*. He roars which way to go, but only friends understand him, so the crew's paths **diverge**, half left, half right. In a temper he rips up the sign to block one, and it only makes the two routes **diverge** further.

{Cookie Monster} tumbles into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive}, where the queen bee **bestows** a golden *shell* on him with great ceremony. {Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} clutching a wriggling *parcel*, evidence for the case. He unwraps it: a slippery *fish*, and a shiny **abalone** clamped to the paper. His grappling hook cannot prise it off, so he tries three gadgets, growling, and the **abalone** suckers onto his cowl, right over the nose.

{Gandalf} arrives in {Front} of the {Warehouse} and taps a giant *wok* with his staff, and it ignites with magical fire. {Lara Croft} vaults {Inside} the {Hangar} through a *shed* whose walls stretch out like chewing gum into a long **corridor** of ancient traps. {Charlie Brown} stands in {Front} of the {Island} hut, whose walls have eaten his kite, and he wants it back. {Gandalf} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond}, raises his staff and enchants a *heron*, who lifts a watering can in its beak. {Mario} jumps into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} and faces a block too heavy to head-butt, while a *dodger* slips away from work. {Mario} warps {Inside} the {Hangar} with his red cap pulled down over each *eye*, so he is completely **blind**. {Zorro} swings into the {Basement} of the {Island} hut from a beam under the *roof*, where a cook plans to **slaughter** vegetables for soup. A red *chili* shakes with fear. {Zorro} leaps into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} and hires an **assistant**: a *standing person* who can use only his *left* hand. {Sherlock} peers {Inside} the {Spa} through his magnifying glass at a little *hut*, where a giant *mouth* sits in a hot tub. '**What**?' he demands, for once unable to deduce anything. The {Joker} sneaks into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} and swaps the *moon* for a prank balloon, cackling. A girl with *long hair* blows in the valve, and it starts to **swell**. It **swells** until planes press against the walls, his grin stretches to match, and bang: a shower of playing cards.

{Charlie Brown} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Hut}, where a *stop sign* has trapped his kite string. {Shrek} retreats to the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut, grumbling, and builds a *small altar* to being left alone, piled with onions. Its candles flare, bells jingle and Donkey bursts in singing, and the ogre's scowl cracks: it is **joy**. He roars a big swampy laugh, and crabs clap along, all overflowing with **joy**.

{Lara Croft} flips {Inside} the {Cat Café} and spots a *swaddled baby* far off along a *road* painted on a wall, a puzzle from some ancient tomb. She climbs, swings and dodges boulders, yet it stays **distant**, its tiny fist waving. Cats watch her ponytail fly by, and when she arrives the baby is more **distant** than ever.

{Mario} jumps into the {Basement} of the {Fort} and stomps a paint pot flat, splattering his overalls. A *helping hand* grabs a *treetop* like a brush and starts to **smear** green across the walls, so he head-butts a block and collects more paint. 'Wahoo!' Together they **smear** the floor and the ceiling until the fort looks like level one.

{Tarzan} swings into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} and bites a long *bamboo* stalk into a hollow **tube**, then drops in a *matching cup*. He takes a breath and lets out his jungle yell. FWOOMP! The cup shoots out, skims over the water and knocks a fish flat; the apes all line up for a **tube**.

{Chewbacca} ducks {Inside} the {Beach} hut to play **chess** with a talking *tree*, the pieces kept in a *winnowing basket*. The tree takes his knight, and he howls, because he hates to lose. In a temper, he rips off a branch, then loyally fixes it with ship tape, and the **chess** goes on, with nobody daring to win.

{Kermit} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} in only a *shirt*, minutes before curtain, and flails his arms: the whole cast has lost their **trousers**. {Casper} hovers in {Front} of the {Island} lighthouse, and the sailors have fled again, so he opens his *mouth* and lets out a long, sad **sigh**. A *full stop* falls out at the end and plops into the waves. He turns invisible, and one more **sigh** rolls out of thin air, frightening the ships, which is the opposite of what he wanted.

{Pikachu} scurries into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, cheeks sparking, and finds only a *tree* and a *fortune stick* reading 'nothing here'. He fires a Thunderbolt, hoping for something dazzling, but the walls are **plain**, the rice is **plain**, and the socks in the chest are **plain** too. {Frodo} limps into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, where a *cashier* with a huge *mouth* starts to **instruct** him: walk to the far end, carry this, do not put it on. He sighs, very weary, and sets off on his bare hairy feet with Sam. The cashier **instructs** him to walk back, and the Ring whispers, so he vanishes.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps into the {Bathroom} of the {Dunes} and finds a camel with a pink *ribbon* round a huge tummy: she is **pregnant**. Yoshi lays eggs all day and thinks he knows everything, so he offers her one. He pats the tummy, a tiny *child* camel kicks his nose from within, and he tries to lay an egg in sympathy, looking very **pregnant** himself.

{Sherlock} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} and deduces from a *snapped stick* that someone has stolen the honey. 'Elementary,' he says, and swears a solemn **vow**, which floats out in a huge *speech bubble*: never to rest till it's solved. Ten thousand bees take the **vow** too, while Watson, stuck to the wall, can only nod.

{Homer} snoozes {Inside} the {Boathouse} when a *marquis* in a powdered wig wakes him, gargling. A doughnut rolls past, and Homer opens his *mouth* so wide that the marquis drops it straight down his **throat**. 'Mmm,' he says, but it sticks, and his 'D'oh' comes out as a gurgle. The marquis peers down with a lantern, and Homer's **throat** gurgles like a drain.

{Walter White} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} with his beakers, and a *woman* dances on a *tombstone* with a plane on her head. He measures her, balances the equation, checks it twice through his glasses, and the result is **absurd**. She claims to be queen of the moon, and each new **absurd** claim makes the plane spin faster, while he furiously rewrites his proud textbook.

{James Bond} saunters in {Front} of the {Museum}, reaching for a statue, and reads a *quotation* on the wall: hands off the art. A *helping hand* shoots out of the plaque to **restrain** him, pinning his tuxedo sleeves. Unruffled, he presses a Q gadget that does nothing but play trumpet, and it **restrains** him tighter as he delivers a one-liner.

{Lara Croft} climbs into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange}, where a *convoy* of tiny stone carts trundles past, each linked by a **chain** of *gold coins*. It's an ancient trap. She grabs hold and swings across the pit, ponytail flying, and the **chain** clinks so loudly that boulders start rolling.

{Charlie Brown} climbs {Inside} the {Beehive}, looking for his kite, and a *scorpion* waves its tail at his *horse*, which bolts with him hanging on. They **speed** past the stairs, past the bees, past Snoopy, who waves. Good grief, he never wins: they **speed** on through the forest, and the kite, stuck in a tree, watches him go.
